content.short: M141X, also known as MADAX is a Cardano metaverse build on top of a real world map.
content.description: M141X, also known as MADAX is a Cardano metaverse built on top of a real world map. You are able to buy land by holding the native Cardano asset called XT. Owning land makes it possible to open portals into the metaverse where you can unleash your creativity.
